_comment: Agentic-loop config for OmniAccelerANT. Engine opencode: planner opencode-go/glm-5.2, executor/fixer opencode-go/deepseek-v4.1-flash. Windows builds and tests run in the family Windows image through scripts/windows/Build-Windows-Container.ps1. Reference: third_party/ANTfrastructure/docs/windows-agentic-loop.md.

promptOverlays._comment: Project deltas on ANTfrastructure's shared role prompts. The composed text is GENERATED into .opencode/agents/<role>.md (gitignored) - edit these files, never that one.

build._comment: Windows: host-side container driver; it always skips docs and MSIX and reuses one container. Tests are the Dart gates in-container via -TestsOnly. Quality commands stay empty - Build-Windows.ps1 runs the Dart+CMake format gate on every loop build. Linux: an adapter mapping the loop's --preset/--build-dir contract onto run-native-linux.sh; NOT yet exercised (the loop has only been run on Windows, and the Linux side additionally needs the opencode CLI on that host).

buildMatrix._comment: Windows names are Build-Windows.ps1 preset aliases; the loop cycles them. sanitizer is none everywhere on purpose: the test phase is Dart-only, so no sanitizer env crosses into the container. Linux names map to a build mode through scripts/linux/agentic-build.sh.
